defects.title: Article Explainer's swarm lets the model emit parallel handoff tool calls (e.g. transfer_to_summarizer + transfer_to_analogy_creator in one AIMessage); only one is executed, leaving an orphan tool_call and crashing the graph with INVALID_CHAT_HISTORY so no answer is produced.
defects.expected_behavior: Disable or serialize parallel handoff tool calls (one transfer per turn), or answer every emitted tool_call with a ToolMessage, so the swarm finishes and returns one final structured answer instead of crashing.
defects.observed_behavior: Reproduced in 2 of 2 valid rounds on 786e84a59211. In both rounds the first model turn of step-1 emitted two parallel handoff tool calls (transfer_to_summarizer + transfer_to_analogy_creator) in one AIMessage; the swarm executed only one, the graph raised INVALID_CHAT_HISTORY on the orphan tool_call, step-1 returned no output, and steps 2-8 failed immediately with the same orphan id. The user got no answer at all.

defects.observed_behavior: Reproduced in 2 of 2 valid rounds on 786e84a59211. In both rounds step-1's single model turn explicitly chose to dispatch the three subtasks 'in parallel' and emitted three handoff tool calls (summarizer, analogy creator, developer) in one AIMessage; the swarm ran only one, LangGraph raised INVALID_CHAT_HISTORY on an orphan tool_call, step-1 returned nothing and steps 2-7 failed with the same orphan id. No answer delivered.
